name: browser-use
headline: agent deck: terminal manager for ai
short_description: Agent Deck is a terminal session manager for AI coding agents. It enables developers to manage multiple AI coding agents in a single terminal session. Built with Go and Bubble Tea, it connects to AI coding assistants like Claude, enhancing productivity and workflow efficiency.
author: asheshgoplani

sections.overview:
Agent Deck is a terminal-based session manager designed for developers working with AI coding agents like Claude. Built with Go and Bubble Tea, it provides a unified interface to manage multiple AI coding agent sessions within a single terminal window. The tool streamlines workflow efficiency by centralizing agent management, reducing context switching between separate terminal windows or applications. It integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI coding assistants to enhance developer productivity. Agent Deck simplifies multi-agent workflows by consolidating session management in an accessible, terminal-native environment.
Fork a session to explore different coding approaches without losing context.
Quickly switch between multiple AI agents to manage tasks across various projects.
Utilize MCP management to automate web searches and browser tasks per project.
Search through all active sessions to find specific tasks or agents instantly.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/asheshgoplani/agent-deck`
sections.usage:
```
Launch Agent Deck and initialize [NUMBER] AI coding agents with the following specifications: [AGENT_SPECIFICATIONS]. Assign each agent to a separate terminal session. Ensure all agents are connected to [AI_ASSISTANT_NAME] for code assistance. Monitor their activities and provide a summary of their progress every [TIME_INTERVAL] minutes.
```
Copy

```
Agent Deck has been successfully launched with 3 AI coding agents. Agent 1 is working on the backend API integration using Python. Agent 2 is refactoring the frontend components in React. Agent 3 is optimizing the database queries in SQL. All agents are connected to Claude for code assistance. Progress summary will be provided every 15 minutes.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
